articles.summary: SAN DIEGO, Sept. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Zentalis ® Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: ZNTL), a clinical oncology innovator advancing late-stage development of investigational first-in-class WEE1 inhibitor azenosertib as a biomarker-driven treatment approach for ovarian cancer, today announced that members of the management team will participate in the following upcoming investor conferences: Wells Fargo 21 st Annual Healthcare Conference, Boston, MA. Fireside discussion, September 8, 2026, 4:30p.m. ET. Morgan Stanley 24 th Annual Global Healthcare Conference, New York, NY. Company presentation, September 14, 2026, 2:35p.m. ET. Access to a live webcast of the Wells Fargo and Morgan Stanley events, as well as an archived recording, will be available under the “Events Presentations” tab on the Investors Media section of the Company’s website . articles.summary: SAN DIEGO, Sept. 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Zentalis ® Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: ZNTL), a clinical oncology innovator advancing late-stage development of investigational first-in-class WEE1 inhibitor azenosertib as a biomarker-driven treatment approach for ovarian cancer, today announced that on September 1, 2026, the Compensation Committee of Zentalis’ Board of Directors granted non-qualified stock options to purchase an aggregate of 269,000 shares of the Company’s common stock to four (4) newly hired employees. The stock options were granted under the Zentalis Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 2022 Employment Inducement Incentive Award Plan (2022 Inducement Plan) as an inducement material to each such individual’s entering into employment with Zentalis in accordance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4).
